content_blocks.label: clause_1._Nature_of_Action
content_blocks.text: The Plaintiff alleges that the Defendant breached the terms of the Confidentiality Agreement by disclosing certain proprietary information without authorization.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Damages_Sought
content_blocks.text: The Plaintiff seeks damages in the amount of $500,000 for the economic harm suffered as a result of the Defendant's breach.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Request_for_Relief
content_blocks.text: The Plaintiff requests that the Court enter an order enjoining the Defendant from further disclosure of the Confidential Information and awarding the requested damages.
